alboNote: Military conscription rolls (Liste di Leva) record every male draftee's exact birth comune and parents' names (paternità e maternità) around age 20.

regiments.name: Alpini
regiments.note: Alpine basins: Piemonte, Valle d'Aosta/Vallée d'Aoste, Liguria alpine notes, Lombardia north, Veneto, Friuli-Venezia Giulia, and Trentino-Alto Adige/Südtirol.

regiments.name: Fanteria
regiments.note: The default line of the district.

fronts.name: Isonzo & Carso / Gorizia
fronts.note: Eleven Isonzo battles, 1915–1917, and the Carso plateau above Gorizia.

fronts.name: Monte Grappa
fronts.note: The Grappa massif held the line between the Brenta and the Piave in 1917–1918.

fronts.name: Altopiano dei Sette Comuni / Asiago
fronts.note: The Asiago plateau, including the Strafexpedition of 1916 and later battles.

fronts.name: Piave & Vittorio Veneto
fronts.note: The Piave line of 1917–1918 and the Vittorio Veneto offensive of October 1918.

fronts.name: Pasubio & Vallarsa
fronts.note: The Pasubio ridge and Vallarsa valley on the Trentino front.

fronts.name: Adamello & Tonale
fronts.note: High-altitude fighting on the Adamello glacier and the Tonale pass.
